latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of websocket-hub-patterns skill.

- Provides horizontally-scalable WebSocket hub architecture with Redis-backed pub/sub.
- Implements lazy Redis subscriptions for efficient resource usage.
- Includes connection registry for distributed instance tracking and scaling.
- Supports graceful shutdown, cleaning up Redis subscriptions and active connections.
- Documents practical Go implementation patterns and anti-patterns for real-time messaging.
